title: One-pot native barcoding of amplicons
author: Josh Quick
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.sg2ebye

steps.title: Prepare End Prep Reaction
steps.instruction: Set up the following reaction for each sample:

substeps.instruction: Add 10 µL DNA amplicons
Add 1.4 µL Ultra II End Prep Reaction Buffer
Add 0.6 µL Ultra II End Prep Enzyme Mix (Total volume: 12 µL)
Incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes
Incubate at 65 °C for 5 minutes
Incubate on ice for 1 minute

steps.title: Add Barcodes and Ligation Mix
steps.instruction: Add the following components directly to the previous reactions, using one native barcode from EXP-NBD104 (1-12) or EXP-NBD114 (13-24) per sample (use 6 to 24 barcodes per library):

substeps.instruction: Add 2.5 µL NBXX barcode
Add 14.5 µL Ultra II Ligation Master Mix
Add 0.5 µL Ligation Enhancer (Total volume: 29.5 µL)

steps.title: Incubate Ligation Reaction
steps.instruction: Perform the following incubation sequence to ligate barcodes and inactivate ligase:

substeps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature for 20 minutes
Incubate at 70 °C for 10 minutes
Incubate on ice for 1 minute

steps.title: Pool and Quantify Amplicons
steps.instruction: Pool all barcoded fragments into a new 1.5 ml Eppendorf tube and quantify the pools.

substeps.instruction: Perform amplicon clean-up using SPRI beads
Quantify the barcoded amplicon pools using the Quantus Fluorometer with the ONE dsDNA assay

steps.title: Set up AMII Adapter Ligation
steps.instruction: Set up the following ligation reaction, ensuring the input of barcoded amplicon pools is between 50 ng (for 6 barcodes) and 200 ng (for 24 barcodes):

substeps.instruction: Add 30 µL Barcoded amplicon pools
Add 10 µL NEBNext Quick Ligation Reaction Buffer (5X)
Add 5 µL AMII adapter mix
Add 5 µL Quick T4 DNA Ligase (Total volume: 50 µL)

steps.title: Incubate Adapter Ligation
steps.instruction: Incubate the reaction at room temperature for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Perform First SPRI Bead Clean-up
steps.instruction: Clean the sample using SPRI beads:

substeps.instruction: Vortex SPRI beads thoroughly until the solution is a homogenous brown colour
Add 50 µL (1:1) of SPRI beads to the sample tube and mix gently by flicking or pipetting
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature
Place on magnetic rack and incubate for 2 minutes or until the supernatant is completely clear
Carefully remove and discard the supernatant without touching the bead pellet

steps.title: Wash Beads with SFB
steps.instruction: Perform two washes with SFB to remove excess adapter:

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL SFB and resuspend beads completely by pipette mixing
Pulse centrifuge to collect all liquid at the bottom of the tube
Remove and discard the supernatant
Repeat these wash steps once more

steps.title: Elute Final Library
steps.instruction: Elute the DNA from the beads:

substeps.instruction: Pulse centrifuge and remove any residual SFB (do not air dry)
Add 15 µL EB and resuspend beads by pipette mixing
Incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes
Place on magnetic rack
Pulse centrifuge to collect all liquid at the bottom of the tube
Transfer final library to a new 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube
